description: Retail, online commerce, wholesale merchandise, transactional store sales, orders, discounts, shipping, profit, and product catalogs.

kpi_templates.name: Total Revenue
kpi_templates.description: Aggregate gross revenue across all transactions.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_sales}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Total Profit
kpi_templates.description: Aggregate net profit generated across all sales.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_profit}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Profit Margin
kpi_templates.description: Net profit margin expressed as a percentage of total revenue.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_profit}) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM({monetary_sales}), 0) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpi_templates.description: Average revenue generated per distinct order transaction.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_sales}) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT {order_id}), 0) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Total Units Sold
kpi_templates.description: Total volume of product units sold.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST(SUM({quantity}) AS BIGINT) AS metric_value FROM df

kpi_templates.name: Average Discount Rate
kpi_templates.description: Average promotional discount rate granted across orders.
kpi_templates.sql_template: SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG({discount}) * 100.0 AS DOUBLE), 2) AS metric_value FROM df

dimensional_templates.description: Revenue and order volume breakdown by product category.
dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST({category} AS VARCHAR) AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_sales}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT {order_id}) AS order_count FROM df WHERE {category} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {category} ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 25

dimensional_templates.description: Net profit and margin breakdown by product category.
dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST({category} AS VARCHAR) AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_profit}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS profit, ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_profit}) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM({monetary_sales}), 0) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS margin_pct FROM df WHERE {category} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {category} ORDER BY profit ASC

dimensional_templates.description: Revenue and order distribution by geographic region.
dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT CAST({region} AS VARCHAR) AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_sales}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT {order_id}) AS order_count FROM df WHERE {region} IS NOT NULL GROUP BY {region} ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 25

dimensional_templates.description: Monthly chronological progression of revenue and order volume.
dimensional_templates.sql_template: SELECT strftime(TRY_CAST({date} AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS entity, ROUND(CAST(SUM({monetary_sales}) AS DOUBLE), 2) AS revenue, COUNT(DISTINCT {order_id}) AS order_count FROM df WHERE {date} IS NOT NULL AND TRY_CAST({date} AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entity ORDER BY entity ASC
